meta.name: reticle
meta.description: Install, instrument and verify this running web app from the inside (DOM, network, routing, console and framework state) instead of screenshots or guessing. Drives one real flow end to end and returns a verdict with the file:line to fix. Use when the user asks to set up or install Reticle, when a user-facing change needs proving before you call it done, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or when the user types /reticle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在真实运行的网页应用里跑通一条完整流程,直接给出可修复的问题定位
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改完前端想确认真的没坏,而不是只靠截图或通过的单测。
copy.tagline_en: Run one real flow inside your running web app and get the exact file:line to fix.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the frontend and need proof it still works, not just a passing test.

howto.what: 它把只用于开发的 SDK 装进正在运行的网页应用，Claude 便能从 DOM、网络、路由、控制台和框架状态内部操作并验证它，走完一条真实流程后给出结论，以及要修的 file:line。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或配置 Reticle、改动收尾前需要验证，或测试通过但界面坏掉时触发；也可以直接输入 /reticle。

say.text: 帮我把 Reticle 装到这个项目里
say.note: 它会检测框架、装 SDK、起开发服务器并等待连接

say.text: 跑一遍结账流程，确认我的改动没问题
say.note: 它会驱动真实应用，返回结论和要改的 file:line

say.text: 测试通过了但页面是坏的，帮我查一下
say.note: 它从 DOM、网络、控制台等通道验证并给出结论

howto.what_en: It embeds a dev-only SDK in the running web app and exposes it as MCP tools, so Claude can drive one real flow end to end and return a verdict with the file:line to fix.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to install or set up Reticle, when a user-facing change needs proving before you call it done, or when a test passes but the UI is broken; also on /reticle.

say_en.note: Detects framework, installs SDK, starts dev server

say_en.text: Drive the checkout flow and confirm my change works
say_en.note: Runs the app and returns a verdict with file:line

say_en.text: The test passes but the UI is broken - check it
say_en.note: Verifies through DOM, network and console
